g.text: Walkthru agent
From start request through the browser loop to the delivered report
Execution flow
Tool, service or data dependency
LangGraph node
External tool
Human / browser
01 Intake and planning / FastAPI and optional runner
Start
Extension journey
User’s Chrome tab
POST /runs with first snapshot
In-app live journey
POST /cloud-runs → queue → worker
Headless Chrome takes first snapshot
Authorize and admit the run
_start_run checks entitlements, quotes and reservations.
Ownership verification sets owner or visitor mode.
Policy gates the site, goal, account state and limits.
Supabase Auth and Data API
Session identity, entitlements, run counters
Live queue, audit and admission records
Target site • ownership proof
Passive verification reads a public marker.
The verification result controls run mode.
Build the ordered goal plan
goal.plan → GoalPlan with up to four proof conditions
Planner error → literal goal fallback
Declared synthetic count → deterministic mission plan
Model gateway • planning
Fast structured call: Groq → Gemini fallback
Configured paid path can prepend Vertex Haiku.
Inputs: owner goal and bounded first observation.
Goal plan
accepted?
Return refusal and end
A refused plan returns 422 and releases the run credit.
The persona graph starts after the plan is accepted.
No
Yes
02 persona_session / StateGraph(SessionState)
Seed state and invoke START
run_id = thread_id • goal, plan, persona and mode
first observation • steps = [] • plan_done = 0
LangGraph checkpointer
SessionState + pending interrupt for each thread
MemorySaver by default. PostgresSaver in production.
Latest observation, action log, proofs, tokens and status.
Storage for resumption lives here.
decide • construct the next PersonaStep
System: owner goal, persona, proof checklist, policy.
Human: bounded prior action facts + latest DOM snapshot.
Structured result: action, target, value, thought and navigation.
One correction for unsupported completion/abandonment.
Model gateway • browser decision
Groq (GPT-OSS and configured fallbacks) → Gemini.
Optional Jev selects from current observed controls.
Optional paid route: Anthropic / Vertex / Z.AI candidate.
Provider health, structured validation and optional receipts.
Context sent to the model
Recent 8 steps + 4 older failures + milestone proofs.
Current control labels and page text, capped at 4,000 chars.
Visual frames stay in evidence storage.
Enforce action policy and record decision
_enforce validates target, viewport, nav revision and policy.
Code stamps current revision and overwrites model progress.
Record action, label, stop code if any, and tokens.
done or
give_up?
act • interrupt with pending action
Persist LangGraph thread. Return action_id from checkpoint_id.
_reply also writes the running status and steps to runs.
Execution hands off to the caller’s browser.
No • browser action
Browser executor • external tool
Chrome extension tab or headless Chrome via CDP.
inject.ts → execute() / executeAsync().
click, type, back, scroll or bounded wait.
Fresh target/revision and origin checks. Live runner
uses a fresh browser session and disallows real sends.
Owner confirmation • extension only
Ask before a verified send or a signed-in form submit.
A declined action produces an executor note.
Settle, observe and resume the same thread
New snapshot + executor result + optional evidence.
/runs/{id}/observe checks ownership and current action_id.
runtime.invoke(Command(resume=...)) re-enters act.
Target website + content script
snapshot() reads bounded DOM, controls and scroll state.
Redaction masks private values. axe and browser vitals
supply optional diagnostics. Masked frames go to storage.
Supabase Storage • run-evidence
Private masked JPEGs, with optional error regions.
Cloud can also store aim frame and pointer.
Observation carries a path and metadata.
act • attach outcome and collect proof
Compare previous vs current observation. Store the URL,
errors, notices, no-change flag, diagnostics and evidence.
goal.evidence checks ordered milestones; optional count
assertion reads the declared visible filter state.
check • advance or terminate
Apply contiguous proof. All checkpoints confirmed → done.
Check step budget, repeated actions and repeat visits.
Handle stale targets, safety boundaries, CAPTCHA/bot wall,
observed site errors and unconfirmed completion.
Yes • direct to check
Status still
running?
Yes • after_check
Stop paths outside the graph
Owner stop, time limit, origin exit or browser error.
Observe can stop a paused run or one with lost live state.
_stop_run records stopped and queues a partial report.
A refused start ends before this path exists.
END • persona graph
_reply saves terminal status, steps, tokens and audit outcome.
Queue report generation for a finished or partial journey.
No • terminal
Supabase Data API • runs row
Durable step log, run status, usage and finished report.
Web live cards and replay read stored results.
The checkpoint store handles graph resumption.
03 Report generation / StateGraph(ReportState)
Queue and claim finish_run
Enqueue with report:{run_id} as the dedupe key.
The worker leases the job and skips an already-saved report.
finish_run reloads the run and rechecks domain verification.
Supabase Postgres • jobs
Durable queue and job lease via the Data API.
Reservation settlement follows a stored report.
START • report graph
Seed ReportState
first_impression
Model reads the first page text.
Skip when there is too little readable text.
accessibility_scan
Static HTML accessibility checks.
Browser axe signals are in the step log.
site_scan
Shared crawl feeds SEO, GEO, passive
security and signup email checks.
stack_scan
Identify framework, hosting and backend
from public headers and page content.
Model gateway • report
Groq, optional OpenRouter writer, Gemini.
Configured Vertex Haiku can run first.
Used by first impression and synthesis.
Website + Cloudflare DNS
Bounded HTTP reads and public crawl.
DNS-over-HTTPS checks mail records.
Shared site audit reuses page responses.
performance_scan
Runs after site_scan on audited URLs.
Requests mobile metrics when configured.
Missing data is marked unavailable.
Google PageSpeed Insights
External mobile performance API.
Only called when its key is configured.
Join all four branches
synthesize
Combine scans, steps, diagnostics and evidence.
Code grounds model-written findings in recorded outcomes.
An unfinished journey with no proven failure gets a code summary.
Build assessment, evidence references and readiness scores.
ReportState
Carries scan outputs, first text, plan, steps and controls.
Parallel branches add notes and token counts.
Each report attempt invokes its own graph.
END • report graph
Enrich and save the report
Attach a prior-run comparison when eligible.
Add paid funnel metrics, then db.set_report writes report v2.
Dashboard and replay can now read the saved result.
Supabase Data API
Stores the report, comparison and run metadata.
Private evidence is fetched through signed URLs.
Deliver the result
notify.report_ready creates the in-app notification.
Optional email contains a link to the report.
Browser UI can open the report and replay evidence.
Resend
External transactional email API.
Used when configured and an owner email exists.
End
Reject at preflight
Auth, policy or entitlement checks can end
the request before the goal planner runs.
Refused
Eligible
Earlier scripted trace
Synthetic observation: click reached /pricing.
A hostname-only setup checkpoint stayed current.
act stopped proof matching at that first item, leaving
plan_done at 0. The model got no rejection reason.
Second done response became agent_lost. Not a live run.
Report job error
Retry with backoff while attempts remain.
Exhausted attempts leave the job marked failed.
Terminal status examples
done · gave_up · budget · stuck
safe_stop · bot_wall · captcha · looping · agent_lost
